_attribution.note: Independently authored. Reference patterns observed in SebTheSigma/JSON-UI-Maker (no LICENSE declared upstream); no source code copied. Names and shapes match Mojang vanilla packs (common.json, common_dialogs.json, common_buttons.json, server_form.json, ui_screens.json, ui_defs.json) which are the de facto vanilla preset surface.
_attribution.verified: Preset names and consumed $variables re-checked on 2026-10-02 against the pinned Mojang bedrock-samples v1.26.50.4 inheritance chains (references/official/bedrock-samples-ui, ui_template_dialogs.json / ui_template_buttons.json / ui_common.json / server_form.json). tests/presets-catalog-vanilla.mjs keeps every ref and variable traceable to those files.

common_refs.purpose: Vanilla generic button skeleton (no textures or text of its own); override $pressed_button_name, supply default/hover/pressed child controls, or extend a common_buttons.* text button instead.
common_refs.note: Confirmed from official bedrock-samples v1.26.50.4: $button_text, $button_text_max_size and the *_button_texture variables are consumed by common_buttons.light_text_button / dark_text_button, not by common.button itself.

common_refs.purpose: Standard 'X' close button used by vanilla dialogs; set $close_button_to_button_id to the button id the close should raise (vanilla dialogs use button.menu_exit).
common_refs.note: Confirmed from official bedrock-samples v1.26.50.4. There is no common.cancel_button in vanilla (an earlier catalog entry listed that name); common.light_close_button is the light-themed variant with the same variables.

common_refs.purpose: Generic scroll_view scaffold with bar/track/viewport sub-controls preconfigured.

common_dialogs_refs.purpose: Title-bar + body modal frame without OK/Cancel; use for forms or custom dialogs (vanilla server_form.long_form and custom_form extend it).
common_dialogs_refs.note: Confirmed from official bedrock-samples v1.26.50.4. Vanilla server_form.long_form still sets $title_panel, but no template in the 1.26.50 inheritance chain consumes it; the title is driven by $text_name.

common_dialogs_refs.purpose: Title-bar + body + two stacked button slots; standard confirm dialog frame.
common_dialogs_refs.note: Confirmed from official bedrock-samples v1.26.50.4: the button slots are $top_button_panel and $bottom_button_panel (an earlier catalog entry listed $button1_panel / $button2_panel, which vanilla never consumed).

common_dialogs_refs.purpose: Centered title label sized for the standard dialog header.

common_buttons_refs.purpose: Light-themed clickable content button used for menu rows / form buttons.
Light text button that vanilla server_form.dynamic_button extends; supply $button_text (literal or binding) and $pressed_button_name.
common_buttons_refs.note: Confirmed from official bedrock-samples v1.26.50.4 (ui_template_buttons.json; $button_text_max_size is read by the common_buttons.new_ui_binding_button_label it places).

server_form_refs.purpose: Default scrolling form layout used by ScriptAPI/Player.sendForm; override $title_text and the body $form_buttons collection.

Inner scrolling body for long_form; the buttons come from the form_buttons collection (server_form.long_form_dynamic_buttons_panel binds #form_button_contents to #collection_length and each server_form.dynamic_button reads #form_button_text / #form_button_texture).

ir_extends_usage.shape: string referencing a vanilla preset, e.g. 'common_dialogs.main_panel_no_buttons'
ir_extends_usage.compiler_behavior: When set, the compiled control name becomes 'name@<extends>' and any 'variables' field on the IR element is emitted verbatim into the JSON UI node. Layout (anchor/offset/size) is still emitted from the solver.
